authorization: 认同你的观点。请你重新设定研究目标，并自主研究
objective: 寻找扣费后做多盈利信息，为原四门与抗扰动目标提供组件证据，不把统计显著性或样本量变成经济硬门
selection_history: 已见EX066-068机会供给、状态和顺序组件结果后的固定新假说；仍是反复研究开发池，不是封存验证

features.short_stretch4: (log(C_T)-log(C_(T-4)))/(volatility20_T*sqrt(4)); volatility20=simple Close pct_change rolling20 sample std ddof1
features.overnight_down_share4: sum_s(T-3..T)max(-(log(O_s)-log(C_(s-1))),0) divided by same overnight sum plus sum_s(T-3..T)max(-(log(C_s)-log(O_s)),0)

hypotheses.short_stretch4: negative relation to next-open-entry h4 net-return proxy

semantics.window: four complete sessions T-3..T, endpoint close T-4; no future rows
semantics.volatility: exact original20 simple-return sample std; no epsilon replacement
semantics.unavailable: short_stretch4 is NaN with explicit short_stretch_reason when20-return history incomplete or volatility=0; retained rows, not economic gate
semantics.no_down: if complete4-session denominator=0 share=0; means no negative overnight/intraday change, not repair
semantics.magnitude: sum negative logarithmic price changes, not squared return energy
semantics.zero_interrupt: not applicable to these aggregate expressions

input.index: finite unique strictly increasing timezone-naive daily-midnight DatetimeIndex; caller validates calendar
input.values: positive finite prices in consistent HFQ units; High/Low/Volume unused

output.availability: all T daily observations formed, earliest T+1 execution
output.warmup: 20 previous sessions needed for20 returns; first4 sessions lack pressure windows

feature_method.parameters: none; fixed4/20 periods and fixed directions, no optimization
limitations: Price patterns do not identify funds, trading pressure or intent.
The overnight move is before proposed T+1 entry and not a tradable label.
Definition and synthetic tests provide no predictive/profit evidence.

label_contract.return_h: Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]*(1-.001)/(1+.001)-1; fractional open-fill fee proxy; h complete sessions held
label_contract.negative_gap_next: Not tested: next open gap is already realized before proposed entry
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all twenty controls, partial residual DF n-rank(design)>=10 required; otherwise unavailable, recording design_rank/residual_df; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: all four predeclared scopes; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 22 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics.scope: all, past20_declining, true original signal-flat eligible, declining-flat; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

scope_definition: EX068 exact scopes; original confirmation_opportunity=eligible AND NOT previous target_position, not actual filled quantity; declining=causal original20daymomentum<0
labels: EX0664/8 net-open labels .999/1.001 and paired downside unchanged byte reuse, not native limit/lot/account returns
partial_residual_df: OLS rank-control design includes intercept; compute actual design rank; n-rank(design)>=10 and original n>=20 required, otherwise explicit unavailable with rank/df; no +/-1 thin-phase claims; bootstrap500x40seed13 unchanged
inputs: EX06820 exact old observations, EX066labels, originalEX058native priced daily plus originalbound.input_bindings.full daily HFQ request2019-04-10..2026-09-29 including original warmup, only existing public assets
price_units: original public HFQ daily units, constant divide by original anchor.2803 only for overlap authentication; feature ratios and originalvol20 recomputed without rounding
stop: 无稳定增量则停止固定方向，不扫期限/窗口/方向/阈值；保留局部正反事实及样本不足
boundaries: 仅S013现有数据至2026-09-30及原warmup，不新provider/外部/跨族/封存/DEV/PTE/生产/账户/参数搜索/32点
limitations: 首19日旧控制缺失保留，零vol不可用；时间顺序非独立封存；市场价标签代理不含限价/整手；真实发布时间修订未验证
